Context: 10. Instructions/ Guidelines relating to filling up the integrity column of Annual Performance Assessment Reports

- (b) The column pertaining to integrity in the character roll should be left blank and a separate secret note about the doubts and suspicions regarding the officer's integrity should be recorded simultaneously and
- followed up.
- (c) A copy of the secret note should be sent together with the character roll to the next superior officers who should ensure that the follow-up action
- is taken with due expedition.
